# GitHub Labels — PropTech Watchers

Mário cria estes 7 labels manualmente em:
GitHub repo → Settings → Labels → New label

| Label | Color | Description |
|-------|-------|-------------|
| healthcheck | #0e8a16 (green) | Watcher healthcheck status |
| incident | #d93f0b (red) | Production incident requires action |
| automated | #cfd3d7 (gray) | Automated watcher output |
| competitor-monitor | #1d76db (blue) | Competitor monitoring digest |
| daily-brief | #fbca04 (yellow) | Daily activity summary |
| weekly-recap | #5319e7 (purple) | Weekly progress recap |
| watcher-stale | #b60205 (red) | Watcher stale beyond 2× cadence |
